notes: print_time_multiplier scales a product's print_hours (1.0 = baseline 120 mm/s bed slinger; resin and SLS batch the whole plate). base_fail_chance_pct is per print before wear, filament condition and preset modifiers. supported_families matches products.json material and filaments.json family. Brand multipliers are already baked into fail chance and speed. Brand and model names are parody.

brands.name: Plodder
brands.personality: Cheapest way in. Loud, slow, needs babysitting, but parts cost pennies and everything is moddable.
brands.strengths: Very cheap, cheap spares, huge upgrade options
brands.weaknesses: Low reliability, slow, poor out of box quality

brands.name: Zippy
brands.personality: Slick plug and play machines with their own multicolour system. Fast and polished, but parts are proprietary and pricey.
brands.strengths: Very fast, great quality, multicolour ready, easy

brands.name: Kestrel
brands.personality: Engineer's choice. Not the fastest, but rock solid, open source and supported for years.
brands.strengths: Best reliability, long part life, great support
brands.weaknesses: Mid speed, pricier than it looks

brands.name: Snapbox
brands.personality: Enclosed, quiet, family and classroom friendly boxes. Easy to run, but small and a bit slow.
brands.strengths: Quiet, enclosed as standard, very easy, good for ABS

brands.name: Bolt & Gantry
brands.personality: Self assembled kit printers loved by tinkerers. Insanely fast once tuned, but your character has to build and tune them.
brands.weaknesses: Kit build time, needs tuning, high maintenance

brands.name: Forge
brands.personality: Heavy enclosed workhorses with heated chambers. Pricey, but they print engineering materials all day.
brands.strengths: High temp materials, heated chamber, big and robust

brands.name: Colossus
brands.personality: Large format printers for props, signage and furniture sized parts. Slow but massive.
brands.weaknesses: Slow, big footprint, warping risk on tall prints

brands.name: Lumina
brands.personality: Resin printers. Ultra fine detail for minis and jewellery, but messy, smelly and need a wash and cure station.
brands.strengths: Best detail, batch printing on one plate
brands.weaknesses: Resin handling, consumable vats and screens, fumes

brands.name: Conveyo
brands.personality: Belt printers that print endlessly long parts or rolls of small parts back to back. Perfect for batch orders.
brands.strengths: Endless batch printing, no plate swaps
brands.weaknesses: Odd print angles, limited part types, tricky setup

brands.name: Sinterforge
brands.personality: Industrial SLS and production machines. Endgame kit for serious B2B volume.
brands.strengths: No supports, nest hundreds of parts, strong nylon parts
brands.weaknesses: Very expensive, needs powder handling and staff
